title: General Properties of the Thermo-Metric for CV event manifolds and the magnetization combinatorial scheme
summary: Following previous results recently obtained by us, on Information Geometry versus Geometrical Thermodynamics and on the exact calculation of partition functions for extended Souriau Gibbs distributions on Calabi Vesentini manifolds, we study the differential geometry of the corresponding thermo-metrics. A general intriguing scheme is discovered and put into evidence. A small yet significant difference, distinguishes the even from the odd dimensional instance of the microscopic CV manifolds.
